description:
the moment you gain FULL ACCESS to your faculties and creativity when out socializing…

is the SAME MOMENT you no longer FEEL like a “separated individual”

the depth of that flow state comes with the feeling of being completely welcome

no doubt, worry, fear or anxiety

theres a sense of being “at one” with the environment

you ARE the group.

you ARE the venue.

the intention shifts from trying to “get” something…

to enjoyment 

your cup has now “runneth over”

and all it took was a little momentum
transcript: The only difference between having a great night out where maybe a couple people want to come home with you and standing at the bar, having a couple drinks, getting extremely anxious, not talking to anybody, and then leaving the venue is what type of momentum you're building. Each of us have a decision tree that starts as soon as we enter the venue. You're either building positive or negative momentum. and the difference between these two are pretty obvious positive momentum is taking action without thinking negative momentum is thinking without taking action so on the negative momentum tree what happens is you walk into the venue and you're like uh i'm gonna go get a drink. So then you walk to the bar and you grab a drink and you're like, what am I going to do? OK, so there's people over here. Who should I talk to? Oh, they're in a bigger group. Oh, she's a little bit too attractive for me. Oh, they're a little bit too far away. And what you're doing is you're building negative momentum, which makes it harder to take action, which then causes you to leave the venue. Whereas positive momentum looks like as soon as you walk into the bar, you just go chat with the first people you see. Hey, how are you guys doing? Brandon, nice to meet you. You guys dating? No, you're just friends? Cool. Really nice to meet you. I'll catch you later. I got to go check my friends. Now you bounce over, you chat with some more people. And what you're doing there is you're building positive momentum, makes taking action easier, puts you into a flow state. Amazing night.
